principle: Token temptation is the default failure mode of Web3 infrastructure projects. Resist by design, not by intention.
context: During sprint round 9, the maintainer asked about token economics. The first draft proposed 4 token-based mechanisms (Retroactive Airdrop, Soulbound Badge, Bonus Multiplier, OP RetroPGF) without reading whitepaper §4.10 first. §4.10 explicitly forbids tokens. The maintainer caught the contradiction. Lesson: when designing a sisoul mechanism, read §4.10 and §4.11 first. They are non-negotiable.
